newsitem.title: UK: Martinair to up rate to HK/Taipei in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Martinair to up rate to HK/Taipei in Nov.

text.p: Martinair NV, the Dutch cargo and passenger charter airline, is planning to announce an increase in rates on the freighter flights in operates to Taiwan and Hong Kong.

Meta Ullings, senior vice president for sales and marketing, cargo, told Reuters that a specific announcement on the rate increase weill be made between now and Nov 1, when they will be implemented. She could give no specific details about the increases at this stage.
She did not discount the possibility that the airline will post increases on other cargo routes, but said no decisions had been taken.
The airline, 50 pct owned by KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV (KLM flies a Boeing 747-400F aircraft twice a week to Hong Kong and three times a week to Taipei.

Martinair's cargo sales department is currently quoting a rate of 2.25 guilders per kg for a consignment weighing a minimum of 150 kgs for freight ex-Amsterdam to either Hong Kong or Taipei. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
